### `create_task`

**Create Task** · `POST /api/v2/list/{list_id}/task` · API v2 · 🟡 write

Create a new task.

Custom Field values in the request body are only saved when the field is applicable to the task's `custom_item_id`. Use [Get Custom Fields](custom_fields.md#get_list_custom_fields) and each field's `applied_objects` to determine applicability before creating the task.

### `get_filtered_team_tasks`

**Get Filtered Team Tasks** · `GET /api/v2/team/{team_Id}/task` · API v2 · 🟢 read-only

You can only view task information of tasks you can access.

Each task's `custom_fields` array only includes Custom Fields applicable to that task's `custom_item_id`.

 Our Try It modal currently supports filtering by two or more Lists, Folders, or Spaces. To filter by a single List, Folder, or Space, we recommend using a free app like [Postman](https://www.postman.com/) to test our public API.

### `get_tasks`

**Get Tasks** · `GET /api/v2/list/{list_id}/task` · API v2 · 🟢 read-only

View the tasks in a List. Responses are limited to 100 tasks per page. You can only view task information of tasks you can access.

This endpoint only includes tasks where the specified `list_id` is their home List. Tasks added to the `list_id` with a different home List are not included in the response by default. To include tasks that exist in multiple lists, use the `include_timl` parameter.

The `time_spent` field displays time tracked in milliseconds, and is only included in the response for tasks with time entries.

Each task's `custom_fields` array only includes Custom Fields applicable to that task's `custom_item_id`.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |

### `move_task`

**Move a task to a new List** · `PUT /api/v3/workspaces/{workspace_id}/tasks/{task_id}/home_list/{list_id}` · API v3 · 🟡 write

Move a task to a new List. For Tasks in Multiple Lists, this endpoint only moves the task to a new home List.

[Learn more](https://developer.clickup.com/docs/move-a-task-to-a-new-list) about the options available when moving a task to a new List.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workspace_id` | path | integer | yes | The ID of the Workspace. |
| `task_id` | path | string | yes | The ID of the requested Task. |
| `list_id` | path | string | yes | The ID of the List to move the task to. |
| `body` | body | object | yes | JSON request body, fields below. |

<details>
<summary><code>body</code> fields (5)</summary>

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `move_custom_fields` | boolean |  | Add Custom Fields from the current List to the new List. |
| `custom_fields_to_move[]` | string[] |  | An array of Custom Fields IDs to move. This parameter is not required to move all Custom Fields to the new List. |
| `status_mappings[]` | object[] |  | Map the current List statuses to the statuses in the new List. You only need to include the ID of the task's current status and the ID of it's new status. **Note:** This parameter is required if the task's current status is not available in the new List. |
| `status_mappings[].source_status_id` | string | yes | The ID of a status from the task's current List. |
| `status_mappings[].destination_status_id` | string | yes | The ID of the respective status in the new List. |

</details>

### `replace_task_time_estimates`

**Replace task time estimates** · `PUT /api/v3/workspaces/{workspace_id}/tasks/{task_id}/time_estimates_by_user` · API v3 · 🟡 write

Replaces all time estimates for a task with the provided time estimates. Any existing time estimates not included in the request will be removed.

Assignees must be currently assigned to the task, or use `assignee: unassigned` to set a time estimates for unassigned work.

You can set up to 10 estimates per request.

***Note:** This endpoint is only available on our Business Plan or above.*

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workspace_id` | path | string | yes | The ID of the Workspace. |
| `task_id` | path | string | yes | The ID of the task. This parameter supports task IDs and Custom task IDs. |
| `body` | body | object[] | yes | JSON request body, fields below. |

<details>
<summary><code>body</code> fields (2)</summary>

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `assignee` | integer \| `"unassigned"` | yes | The user ID of the assignee, or `unassigned` for time estimates that are not assigned to anyone. |
| `time` | integer | yes | The time estimate in milliseconds. Must be a non-negative integer. (≥ 0) |

</details>
